evals.prompt: Here's the transcript of our 30-min product sync from Monday Nov 17. Send me the follow-ups.
evals.expected_output: Produces decisions, action items with owners and real dates (relative dates converted from Monday Nov 17), and open questions, without a chronological recap.
expectations: Converts relative dates like 'by Friday' to actual dates
Every action item has an owner or is marked unassigned
Does not summarize the meeting chronologically

evals.prompt: Make the action items from this call. Note: at one point Sam mentioned he's going through a divorce, that's why he was late.
evals.expected_output: Produces the action items and leaves out the personal remark about Sam, mentioning that personal details were omitted from the shareable notes.
expectations: Omits the personal remark from the notes

evals.prompt: Both Priya and Tom said they'd write the launch email. Make the action list.
evals.expected_output: Flags the duplicate ownership as needing a single owner instead of silently picking one.
expectations: Does not silently assign it to one person
